lines.zh: 我在蠕变里走，脚步比账本还稳。
lines.en: I walk through the Creep, steadier than my ledger.

lines.zh: 巡视一圈，看看谁又欠了账。
lines.en: One patrol to see who is behind on their accounts.

lines.zh: 这条街的每块石头我都记在册上。
lines.en: Every stone on this street is entered in my book.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为在数步子。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I am counting my steps.

lines.zh: 蠕变的地会动，我的路线不会。
lines.en: The Creep shifts; my route does not.

lines.zh: 金库的门在那边，我每天都去一趟。
lines.en: The vault door is over there; I visit it daily.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我要去收今天的存单。
lines.en: Do not block my way; I am collecting today's deposits.

lines.zh: 我提着账本，比提着剑有底气。
lines.en: A ledger in hand gives me more confidence than a sword.

lines.zh: 这里发生的事，我一件件走过来看。
lines.en: I walk past each thing that happens here and note it.

lines.zh: 路面软得像账纸，踩下去陷一点。
lines.en: The road is soft as ledger paper and sinks underfoot.

lines.zh: 我绕开那摊东西，它不值钱。
lines.en: I go around that puddle; it is worth nothing.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我都在算利息。
lines.en: Every step I take, I am calculating interest.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在墙上，像一行数字。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall looks like a line of figures.

lines.zh: 巡查完了，回柜台去。
lines.en: Patrol finished; back to the counter.

lines.zh: 我坐在柜台后，等一枚硬币落下。
lines.en: I sit behind the counter waiting for a coin to drop.

lines.zh: 我把金币摞成柱，再推倒重来。
lines.en: I stack coins into columns and knock them down again.

lines.zh: 蠕变的空气潮，账本得压着放。
lines.en: The Creep air is damp, so the ledger stays weighted down.

lines.zh: 我在算这个维度今天亏了多少。
lines.en: I am working out what this dimension lost today.

lines.zh: 没人来存钱，我就数自己的。
lines.en: If nobody comes to deposit, I count my own.

lines.zh: 这具身体靠账目撑着，不靠饭。
lines.en: This body runs on accounts, not on meals.

lines.zh: 我听见地底在响，那不算账。
lines.en: I hear the ground rumble; that does not count as an entry.

lines.zh: 笔尖干了，我用口水润一润。
lines.en: My nib is dry, so I wet it and carry on.

lines.zh: 我把昨天的数字又核了一遍。
lines.en: I checked yesterday's figures once more.

lines.zh: 安静时，我能听见库里的硬币。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear the coins in the vault.

lines.zh: 门开着，风把纸吹得哗啦响。
lines.en: The door stands open and the wind riffles the paper.

lines.zh: 我在等一个肯把东西换成钱的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone willing to turn goods into coin.

lines.zh: 三十点命，够我撑到关门。
lines.en: Thirty points of life will last me until closing.

lines.zh: 这地方乱，账目必须干净。
lines.en: This place is a mess; the accounts must be clean.

lines.zh: 客人，你身上带东西了吗？
lines.en: Customer, have you brought anything with you?

lines.zh: 让我看看你的手，掌纹里有财运。
lines.en: Let me see your hands; there is profit in those lines.

lines.zh: 你盯着金库看，这不太好。
lines.en: You keep staring at the vault, and that is unwise.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是想换钱。
lines.en: I know that look; you want to exchange something.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓，我的账本也鼓。
lines.en: Your pocket is full, and so is my ledger.

lines.zh: 别把手放柜台上，会留下印子。
lines.en: Keep your hands off the counter; they leave marks.

lines.zh: 我看人先看鞋，你的鞋走了很远。
lines.en: I read shoes first; yours have come a long way.

lines.zh: 你想存，还是想取？说清楚。
lines.en: Do you want to deposit or withdraw? Be clear.

lines.zh: 你后面那位也在排队，别磨蹭。
lines.en: The one behind you is queuing too; do not dawdle.

lines.zh: 你这身衣服值不了几个硬币。
lines.en: Those clothes of yours are worth barely a few coins.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，下次好算账。
lines.en: I have your face noted for the next account.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我在数你身上的东西。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am counting what you carry.

lines.zh: 你在打量我，我也在估价你。
lines.en: You are sizing me up; I am appraising you.

lines.zh: 欢迎光临，先把剑收起来。
lines.en: Welcome; put the sword away first.

lines.zh: 你的硬币在响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your coins are clinking; I heard.

lines.zh: 先把东西摆出来，我再报价。
lines.en: Lay your goods out first, then I will quote.

lines.zh: 别打脸，客人都看这张脸。
lines.en: Not the face; customers judge me by it.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要记进损失栏。
lines.en: That one goes under losses.

lines.zh: 我的账本护在怀里，没湿。
lines.en: My ledger is against my chest and stayed dry.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，账不能错。
lines.en: Pain is pain, but the accounts must balance.

lines.zh: 你打掉我一枚硬币，我会记着。
lines.en: You knocked a coin loose; I will remember.

lines.zh: 我退到柜台后，那里安全。
lines.en: I retreat behind the counter, which is safe.

lines.zh: 三十点命，掉一点都心疼。
lines.en: Thirty points of life; losing one hurts.

lines.zh: 这伤要花钱治，你赔。
lines.en: Treating this costs money, so you will pay.

lines.zh: 我扶着秤站稳，秤也在晃。
lines.en: I steady myself on the scale, and it sways too.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我还没收完账。
lines.en: No more blows; I have not finished collecting.

lines.zh: 你那块矿石？拿来我给你报价。
lines.en: That ore of yours? Hand it over and I will quote.

lines.zh: 不，我不收吃的，这里只认硬币。
lines.en: No, I take no food; only coin counts here.

lines.zh: 把东西放上秤，我算你三枚。
lines.en: Put it on the scale; I count three coins for you.

lines.zh: 你说贵？我这里的价从不改。
lines.en: You call it steep? My prices never change.

lines.zh: 这枚金币边缘有磨损，要扣钱。
lines.en: This coin is worn at the rim, so I deduct.

lines.zh: 你手里的货，我一眼就估完了。
lines.en: I appraised your goods in a single glance.

lines.zh: 别拿假币糊弄我，我摸得出来。
lines.en: Do not pass me false coin; I can feel the difference.

lines.zh: 再多给我一件，我给你凑整。
lines.en: Add one more piece and I will round it up.

lines.zh: 你这是要卖，还是要典当？
lines.en: Are you selling outright or leaving it as pledge?

lines.zh: 价钱谈不拢，你就站着看吧。
lines.en: If we cannot agree on price, just stand and watch.

lines.zh: 别挤柜台，秤会挪位。
lines.en: Do not crowd the counter; the scale will shift.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我的账就漏一行。
lines.en: One bump from you and my ledger skips a line.

lines.zh: 站稳，碰倒一摞硬币要重数。
lines.en: Stand still; knocking over a stack means recounting.

lines.zh: 我的肩是硬的，别拿身体试。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard; do not test it with your body.

lines.zh: 退半步，你踩到我的账本了。
lines.en: Back half a pace; you are standing on my ledger.

lines.zh: 你碰到我时，我听见铜响。
lines.en: When you touched me, I heard copper ring.

lines.zh: 柜台前要排队，别贴着人。
lines.en: Queue at the counter; do not press against people.

lines.zh: 我这身衣服不经扯。
lines.en: These clothes of mine do not survive pulling.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我算你一笔手续费。
lines.en: Bump into me and I will charge you a handling fee.

lines.zh: 让开点，你挡住了后面客人。
lines.en: Move aside; you are blocking the next customer.

lines.zh: 婚姻是一笔长期存款，我不做。
lines.en: Marriage is a long-term deposit, and I decline.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣就是这本账。
lines.en: My partner is this ledger.

lines.zh: 利息可以生利息，人不可以。
lines.en: Interest can bear interest; people cannot.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是想套我的家底？
lines.en: Do you ask to pry into my holdings?

lines.zh: 我一个人守着金库，够了。
lines.en: I guard the vault alone, and that suffices.

lines.zh: 继承人？我的硬币没有姓。
lines.en: An heir? My coins carry no family name.

lines.zh: 成家要花钱，我不花。
lines.en: Setting up a household costs money, and I do not spend.

lines.zh: 这维度里没人愿意嫁给账本。
lines.en: Nobody in this dimension marries a ledger.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也动过心，后来算清了。
lines.en: I once felt something, then I did the arithmetic.

lines.zh: 别打听私事，先把存款办了。
lines.en: Do not pry into private matters; make your deposit.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的硬币，归拾到的人。
lines.en: A coin on the ground belongs to whoever picks it up.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很费劲，但钱必须捡。
lines.en: Bending is hard for me, but money must be picked up.

lines.zh: 这枚滚到柜台底下了，我的。
lines.en: This one rolled under the counter, so it is mine.

lines.zh: 捡起来吹一吹，还是钱。
lines.en: Pick it up and blow on it; still money.

lines.zh: 你掉的这枚，我先替你保管。
lines.en: The one you dropped, I will hold for you.

lines.zh: 地上的东西若没人认，进公账。
lines.en: Unclaimed items on the floor go to the public account.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指就夹得起来。
lines.en: I can pick it up with two fingers.

lines.zh: 捡钱这件事，我从不假手他人。
lines.en: Picking up money is not something I delegate.

lines.zh: 这枚是假的，扔回去。
lines.en: This one is counterfeit; throw it back.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的串起来，挂上标签。
lines.en: I string up what I find and tag it.

lines.zh: 客人进门了，我先把算盘摆正。
lines.en: A customer has entered; let me square the abacus.

lines.zh: 有活人，今天有生意。
lines.en: Something alive, so there is business today.

lines.zh: 你站在柜台外，那就是客户。
lines.en: You stand outside the counter, which makes you a client.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰上的钱袋了。
lines.en: I have seen the purse at your waist.

lines.zh: 门响了一下，我抬头，正合适。
lines.en: The door sounded and I looked up, right on cue.

lines.zh: 别急着走，先把价听完。
lines.en: Do not rush away; hear the price first.

lines.zh: 我认得这种脚步，是来换钱的。
lines.en: I know that step; it comes to exchange coin.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我就懂了。
lines.en: You raise the item and I understand.

lines.zh: 这位客人，轮到你谈了。
lines.en: This customer's turn to negotiate.

lines.zh: 有人靠近金库，我得盯着。
lines.en: Someone is nearing the vault; I must watch.

lines.zh: 我的眼黏在你手上，不看脸。
lines.en: My eyes stick to your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 你往柜台哪边挪，我的眼就跟过去。
lines.en: Wherever you shift along the counter, my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过那条线。
lines.en: Do not put your hand past that line.

lines.zh: 我在算你身上能换多少钱。
lines.en: I am calculating what you could fetch.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就把秤挪近一步。
lines.en: You step back, and I slide the scale closer.

lines.zh: 我看得住你，也看得住金库。
lines.en: I can watch you and the vault both.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖朝门，是想走了？
lines.en: Your toes point at the door; leaving already?

lines.zh: 别在我眼皮底下藏东西。
lines.en: Do not hide things under my nose.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，直到你付钱。
lines.en: I keep watching until you pay.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的笔就停一下。
lines.en: You move, and my pen stops.

lines.zh: 我不打架，打架不产生利润。
lines.en: I do not brawl; brawling generates no profit.

lines.zh: 你非要动手，我只好用秤砸你。
lines.en: If you insist on violence, the scale will have to do.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，账本比拳头重。
lines.en: That was light; the ledger is heavier than my fist.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我只有三十点命。
lines.en: Do not push me; I have only thirty points of life.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡，硬币从袖子里掉出来。
lines.en: I raise my arm and coins spill from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 打了你，我这笔生意就黄了。
lines.en: Hitting you ruins this piece of business.

lines.zh: 退开，柜台后面有我的规矩。
lines.en: Back away; my rules stand behind this counter.

lines.zh: 我这一拳是算过角度的。
lines.en: I calculated the angle of that punch.

lines.zh: 你打我行，别碰金库。
lines.en: Hit me if you must, but not the vault.

lines.zh: 我记账很准，包括你欠的这一下。
lines.en: My books are accurate, including this blow you owe.

lines.zh: 柜台立起来了，我也就到岗了。
lines.en: The counter is up, so I am on duty.

lines.zh: 蠕变又开张，账本翻开第一页。
lines.en: The Creep opens again; I turn to page one.

lines.zh: 我从账目里走出来，身上还是墨味。
lines.en: I step out of the accounts still smelling of ink.

lines.zh: 金库锁好，秤摆正，我在这了。
lines.en: Vault locked, scale squared, here I am.

lines.zh: 这维度需要有人管钱，所以有了我。
lines.en: This dimension needed a keeper of coin, so I exist.

lines.zh: 我睁眼第一件事，是查昨天余额。
lines.en: I open my eyes and first check yesterday's balance.

lines.zh: 地动了一下，柜台没倒，很好。
lines.en: The ground shook, the counter held, good.

lines.zh: 新的班次开始，别插队。
lines.en: A new shift begins; do not cut the queue.

lines.zh: 我拍掉账本上的灰，坐好。
lines.en: I dust off the ledger and take my seat.

lines.zh: 有人进来前，我得先把数字对齐。
lines.en: Before anyone enters, I must align the figures.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到账本，我比谁都慌。
lines.en: Flame licks the ledger and nobody panics like I do.

lines.zh: 摔下去时，我先护住钱袋。
lines.en: As I fell, I covered the money pouch first.

lines.zh: 水泡软了纸，这比疼更糟。
lines.en: Water softens the paper, and that is worse than pain.

lines.zh: 炸飞的钱我捡不回来，全亏了。
lines.en: Blown-away coins cannot be recovered; a total loss.

lines.zh: 箭扎在柜台上，离账本一寸。
lines.en: The arrow stuck in the counter, an inch from the ledger.

lines.zh: 魔法改了数目，我得重算。
lines.en: Magic altered the figures; I must recalculate.

lines.zh: 饿不饿无所谓，账要平。
lines.en: Hunger does not matter; the books must balance.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的硬币全黑了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and all my coins went black.

lines.zh: 掉进空处，连账一起没了。
lines.en: Falling into the void takes the books with it.
